meaning:
1) to tear away, seize, plunder, tear off, pull off, rob, take away by force
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to tear away, rob
1a2) to seize, plunder (with acc cognate)
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to be robbed
1b2) to be taken away

renderings.kjv: because he hath violently taken away

elsewhere.note: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
